info.longBusinessSummary: Commercial Metals Company manufactures, recycles, and fabricates steel and metal products, and related materials and services in the United States, Poland, China, and internationally. It operates through three segments: North America Steel Group, Construction Solutions Group, and Europe Steel Group. The company processes and sells ferrous and nonferrous scrap metals. It also offers finished long steel products, including reinforcing bars, merchant bars, light structural and other special sections, and wire rods, as well as semi-finished billets for rerolling and forging applications. In addition, the company provides fabricated rebar used to reinforce concrete; sells and rents construction-related products and equipment; and manufactures and sells strength and armor plates. Further, it sells wire meshes, welded steel mesh, wire rod, cold rolled rebar, cold rolled wire rod, assembled rebar cages and other fabricated rebar by-products. The company was founded in 1915 and is headquartered in Irving, Texas.
